title: Legendary Items
subtitle: Every item tells a story — from Precursor times to the modern era

cards.title: Virtue Gems — Source of All Power
cards.text: Crystallized energy of The Beast. The Azmeri called them "Tears of Maji." The Vaal used blood sacrifice to activate them. Each Gem contains a "Volition" — a primitive consciousness. The Karui forbid their use due to Blood Fever — a violent frenzy.
cards.quote: Virtue Gems — fragments of a cosmic entity's will, whispering to their wielders.
cards.flavorText: "This stone whispers. You just need to know how to listen." — Malachai

cards.title: Vaal Gems & Corruption
cards.text: Transforming Virtue Gems with dark energy. Vaal Gems — extremely powerful but cost souls. The Seed of Corruption is a product of the Second Edict — created by Precursors intentionally.
cards.flavorText: "Corruption does not destroy. It liberates." — Doryani
